run_forward: run the mjx warp forward function to compute forward dynamics for a MuJoCo model and data
run_step: run the mjx warp step function to advance a MuJoCo simulation by one timestep
test_forward: test the mjx warp forward function with a MuJoCo model and data for batched simulation
test_step: test the mjx warp step function with a MuJoCo model and data for batched simulation
review_forward: review the mjx warp forward function that maps JAX model and data to Warp arrays for GPU execution
